candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns HTTP 500; traces and logs show the order service failing with 500, propagating as 502 at the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within the order service (db, payment, inventory) is not established; only the 500 propagation is observed.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s are explained by order service returning 500 on POST /v1/orders, seen consistently in traces and logs. The underlying fault inside order is not yet evidenced, so the candidate is bounded to the observed 500 propagation.
